neighbours.label: sentence-ending punctuation inside non-English (esp. CJK, German, Arabic) prose
fire: 우리는 어제 시장에 갔습니다. 사과와 배를 많이 샀습니다. 집에 와서 같이 먹었습니다.
我昨天去了图书馆。那里的人很多。我借了三本书。
Der Zug kam pünktlich an. Wir stiegen schnell ein. Die Fahrt dauerte zwei Stunden.
这家餐厅的菜很好吃。价格也不贵。我们下次还会再来。
Meine Mutter kocht jeden Sonntag Suppe. Alle Kinder kommen zum Essen.
학생들은 아침 일찍 학교에 도착했습니다. 선생님이 수업을 시작했습니다.
Die Ausstellung ist bis Ende Mai geöffnet. Der Eintritt ist frei.
他每天早上跑步。身体越来越好了。朋友们都很羡慕他。
quiet: We went to the market yesterday. We bought many apples and pears. At home we ate them together.
I went to the library yesterday. There were many people. I borrowed three books.
The train arrived on time. We boarded quickly. The trip took two hours.
The food at this restaurant is very good. The prices are not high. We will come again.
My mother makes soup every Sunday. All the children come to eat.
The students arrived at school early in the morning. The teacher started the lesson.
The exhibition is open until the end of May. Admission is free.
He runs every morning. His health keeps improving. His friends envy him.

notes: Card top: '.' / '。' at sentence ends in Korean, Chinese, German, Arabic. Probe: German 0.29, Chinese 0.34, Korean 0.16, English 0.01-0.03. Weak relative to max.
